headline: Google can quietly stop showing your new reviews
dek: A two-location HVAC company had new reviews blocked for weeks with no notice from Google. It took repeated support requests to get it fixed.
why: A silent block stalls your review count for weeks, and most owners only notice once rankings or calls slip.
doThis: Compare the reviews customers say they left in the last 30 days with what shows on your profile. Spread review requests out instead of sending a burst.
